# Edit project — by hand

Plain steps by what the page shows, for when no automated method works: follow them with ordinary clicks and typing, or give them to the user. Take every value from the user and never invent one. If a login page, CAPTCHA or two-factor prompt appears, the user has to deal with it.

1. Open the app's /projects/:projectId/edit page.
2. **The form**
    - Project name: type it (text, up to 100 chars). Required.
    - Status: choose one (Planned · Active · Paused · Done). Required.
    - Due date: type it (date, YYYY-MM-DD).
3. Check every value, then click "Save changes", and only when the user has asked to submit.
